title: Tim Dooley — Under-Mined Prediction Domains Audit — 2026
status: canonical cross-domain recovery audit; no new strict-fulfilled promotion
purpose: Preserve prediction-like material recovered from domains that had received little dedicated prediction mining, while separating genuine prospective candidates from weak structural forecasts, retrospective-only claims, vague themes and material that is not a prediction at all.

strict_fulfilled_master_unchanged.reason: None of the newly recovered under-mined-domain items in this audit currently clears the existing requirement of a recoverable pre-event Tim statement plus an independently dated later external outcome strongly matching the frozen predicted component.

classification.real_candidate: Prospective enough to test, with a concrete direction, mechanism, named region/entity, time window or observable consequence. It may still need exact primary wording or later outcome scoring.
classification.weak_candidate: Contains future direction but is broad, conditional, partly already observable, or lacks an operational definition.
classification.legacy_recovery: A remembered or later-recorded prediction claim that could become strong if a contemporaneous pre-event source and independent outcome chronology are recovered.
classification.vague_theme: Directional worldview or symbolic framing that can fit many later outcomes and should not be counted as a prediction without further specification.
classification.not_prediction: Classification, policy preference, proposal, present-tense diagnosis, speculative hypothesis, symbolism or retrospective interpretation rather than a genuine forecast.

rejected_or_non_prediction_material.reason: Assigning countries or subregions to North/West/East/South is a classificatory model unless the original statement explicitly predicts a future transition.
India/Pakistan/Bangladesh East-facing or Sri Lanka/Maldives hinge classifications are map structure, not forecasts.
Country-level East/South assignments and an ASEAN bridge description are not predictions unless phrased prospectively with observable change criteria.
A speculative physical model or hypothesis is not an event prediction. It belongs in science with falsifiable experimental/model criteria.
Technology forcing continuous retraining is too generic to count without dates, occupations, institutions, thresholds or a specific policy transition.
Lower costs, better schools, gardens or halls of learning are program goals or future-building proposals, not forecasts.
Reducing incarceration, reorganizing agencies, audits or legal reform targets are policy proposals unless separately phrased as predictions of what institutions will actually do.
Discussion of city hall, regional bodies, businesses, property disputes or civic relationships is not a forecast by itself.

Current recovery work raises a serious possibility that the remembered 4.2% item was present-state wording rather than a prospective call. It must not be promoted until the exact original turn proves future tense, measure and horizon.

integrity_rules: No item in this audit changes the strict fulfilled count by itself.
Do not turn geographic classification into prediction after seeing later alignments.
Do not turn a proposal into a forecast because an institution later adopts a similar policy.
Do not turn a health-risk warning into a death prediction unless the original wording says so.
Do not use assistant-generated elaboration as Tim-originated prediction evidence.
Retain misses, non-predictions and vague themes next to positive candidates to prevent success-only curation.
Split compound forecasts into testable atoms only after recovering the original statement and freezing interpretation before outcome scoring.
